notes.en: Mount Gay 1703 holds the Barbados profile through dry oak, dried fruit and measured vanilla. In the glass expect medium body, tidy texture and a calm finish that does not push sweetness forward.

notes.hr: Leblon je cachaça iz Minas Geraisa, destilirana iz svježeg soka šećerne trske (ne melase) i kratko odmarana u rabljenim bačvama XO konjaka. Stil je lagan, cvjetan i travnat s voćnim rubom — čist za sipanje, ali doma je u Caipirinhi. Cachaça je brazilski rođak ruma: ista trska, ali svježi sok i vlastiti zakon.
notes.en: Leblon is a cachaça from Minas Gerais, distilled from fresh sugarcane juice (not molasses) and briefly rested in used XO cognac casks. The style is light, floral and grassy with a fruity edge — clean enough to sip, but at home in a Caipirinha. Cachaça is Brazil's cousin of rum: same cane, but fresh juice and its own law.

notes.hr: Novo Fogo je certificirano organska cachaça iz Morretesa (Paraná), na rubu atlantske prašume. Silver je nedozrela i travnata; bačvaste verzije (Barrel-Aged u ex-bourbon hrastu, Two Woods s brazilskim ariribá drvom) dodaju vaniliju, banane i mekani začin. Zanatski pristup s malim serijama.
notes.en: Novo Fogo is a certified-organic cachaça from Morretes (Paraná), on the edge of the Atlantic rainforest. The Silver is unaged and grassy; the barrel-aged bottlings (Barrel-Aged in ex-bourbon oak, Two Woods with Brazilian ariribá wood) add vanilla, banana and soft spice. A small-batch, craft approach.

notes.hr: Avuá je zanatska single-estate cachaça s Fazende da Quinta (Rio de Janeiro). Prata je nedozrela i bistra; posebne su verzije dozrele u domaćim brazilskim drvima — Amburana daje cimet, klinčić i tonku, Bálsamo smolu i med, a Oak i Tapinhoã dublju drvenu strukturu. Ovo je cachaça kao ozbiljan destilat za sipanje.
notes.en: Avuá is an artisanal single-estate cachaça from Fazenda da Quinta (Rio de Janeiro). The Prata is unaged and clear; the standout bottlings rest in native Brazilian woods — Amburana gives cinnamon, clove and tonka, Bálsamo resin and honey, while Oak and Tapinhoã add deeper woody structure. This is cachaça as a serious sipping spirit.

notes.hr: Germana je obiteljska zanatska cachaça iz Nove Uniãa (Minas Gerais), dozrijevana u bačvama od bálsama i hrasta. Profil je topao i drvenast — suho voće, tostirani hrast i blagi začin — a vrhunska Heritage izdanja idu do 18 godina starosti. Tradicionalni alambique stil.
notes.en: Germana is a family-run artisanal cachaça from Nova União (Minas Gerais), aged in bálsamo and oak casks. The profile is warm and woody — dried fruit, toasted oak and gentle spice — with top Heritage bottlings going up to 18 years old. A traditional alembic style.
